title: Prefixes in-/im-/ir-/il- (not), dis- · How Money Works (barter → currency)
goal: Read, spell, and use words with the "not" prefix family (*in-, im-, ir-, il-*) and *dis-*; continue the fluency program on a new passage; keep clearing the Fry heart-word list.
newToday: *in-/im-/ir-/il-* ("not") and *dis-* — together with *un-*, these are the **top 4 prefixes**, covering ~58% of all prefixed words in school reading material (White, Sowell & Yanagihara 1989 — research/05 §1). Tier-2 words: *valuable*, *convenient*.
review: *un-, re-* — 3 quick words each (*unlock, uncertain, redo*) before moving on.
